pages.title: Shock
pages.text: Shock is violent and stressful, possibly the least pleasant area of the Ruins. You'll want to keep moving while you're here: the slower you move, the darker the sky will get, and lightning will strike closer and closer. This is made difficult by the soul sand covering most of the ground.

The typhlotic beasts of Shock are called $(bold)snuffers$(). Like sniffers, they have very acute noses, and will track your scent trail through their native biome, converging from a distance on where you have previously stepped. If struck by lightning, a snuffer will gain a brief but intense speed boost.
